hero.title: MarketGo
hero.subtitle: A web platform for managing inventory, lots, conservation, and supply operations for organic products between minimarkets and suppliers.

services.title: Centralized control for fresh products
services.subtitle: MarketGo organizes critical minimarket information and improves supplier coordination from a shared dashboard.

catalog.title: Inventory and lots
catalog.description: Register organic products, review stock, organize lots, and track expiration dates.

orders.title: Supply orders
orders.description: Connect suppliers and minimarkets to create, review, accept, or reject traceable orders.

analytics.title: Conservation and alerts
analytics.description: Monitor temperature, humidity, and products at risk to reduce waste and act on time.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Reduce losses and improve management
mission.description: Centralize inventory, conservation, and supply so minimarkets work with clear information.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: A more connected organic ecosystem
vision.description: Support sustainable operations between stores and suppliers through traceability and digital coordination.

benefits.title: Less waste, more traceability, better decisions
benefits.subtitle: The landing communicates the value of a platform built for real organic product operations.

speed.title: Early detection
speed.description: Expiration and conservation alerts help teams act before products deteriorate.

control.title: Clear roles and permissions
control.description: Administrators and suppliers share information while operating under their own responsibilities.

growth.title: Organized supply
growth.description: Accepted orders can feed inventory while keeping history and control.

panel.label: Key focus
panel.description: Inventory, lots, suppliers, orders, and alerts are presented as one operation.

testimonials.title: Designed for teams managing time-sensitive products
testimonials.subtitle: Messages aimed at minimarket administrators and organic product suppliers.
